name: github-annotated
title: What each scm: relation did, on GitHub’s own page
html:
What each scm: relation did, on GitHub’s own page

  1. scm:pulls-get
    Read pull request 2337, kept as pr.
  2. state, merged
    state: closed, merged: true, read after the act.
  3. head.sha
    The head the view had: GitHub merges only if it’s still there.
  4. scm:merge {method: squash}
    Squashed into library/main as 1361304.
  5. scm:comment {body}
    “Not promoted to Dev: smoke scenarios S3 failed.”
say: Pull request #2337 on real GitHub, variant 504: merged, then the smoke test failed scenario S3, so it wasn't promoted and the script commented. Each box is something one scm: relation read or did. The page is GitHub's; ARTIE never saw it, only the gateway's HAL Schema Forms.
